skill.summary: Generate 10 optimized viral LinkedIn posts per topic with engagement scores, hashtag strategies, posting time tips, and formats to boost B2B lead generation.

latestVersion.changelog:
AI LinkedIn Post Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generates 10 viral LinkedIn posts per topic, optimized for engagement and lead generation.

- Workflow automates trend research, post generation, and actionable output with Apify-powered data.

- Provides a complete execution guide for B2B professionals, founders, agencies, and marketers.
